source: known difference: #89: docx-agent rolls the tree back, but its id pool and aliases keep what the stamping drew; the Rust core changes nothing (tool rule 3: a no-op changes nothing). A docx-agent leftover, not copied.

known difference: docx-agent's insert_control takes the position unchecked and fails inside new_run with Python's IndexError ('list index out of range', not_found); the Rust core refuses the position, saying how many characters the paragraph has (as word_notes refuses one). A docx-agent crash, not copied.
